description: Plan 032 Faz 032g — kernel-owned MCP server registry. A spawn loads ONLY the servers its runtime profile names (`mcp_servers`), always under --strict-mcp-config, so the repository's .mcp.json never reaches an autonomous agent. env_passthrough carries NAMES; secret-shaped names are refused at load time. ARIA-HIGH-124: the kernel's own server is `kernel_socket` — served OUTSIDE the sandbox by the executor (aria_kernel.mcp_broker) and reached through the stdlib relay (aria_kernel.mcp_relay) the spawner renders; the store is never mounted inside.

aria.description: Read-only view of the ARIA store (status, missions, findings, pressures, governance, handoffs, daily report, search, delivery, progress), served by the executor outside the sandbox over a bound socket. Write tools are unreachable for agents by construction; operators run `aria-kernel mcp serve --allow-writes` themselves.
